items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered a non-contact knee injury late in the win over Patriots; already ruled out, more tests today. Coach Ben Johnson: 'I don’t think it looked very good.'
items.why: Non-contact knee buckle, carted off, coach comments negative; tests pending but appears significant.
items.implication: Bears TE vacuum; reduced 2-/3-TE sets likely boosts WR route rates.
items.opportunity: Higher WR snaps/routes for Burden and others

items.text: Luther Burden has run only 68.8% of routes this season but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite efficiency on limited routes; TE absence historically opens more WR opportunities in Bears offense.
items.implication: Immediate WR upside boost ROS and this week; monitor snap/route share.
items.opportunity: Route rate expansion beyond 68.8%, higher targets

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua suffered what is believed to be a minor calf injury; Colts have decision on Jonathan Taylor.
items.why: GMFB report minor; practice exit confirmed. JT multi-team interest post-Ballard firing.
items.implication: Puka likely plays but monitor; JT trade speculation elevates short-term uncertainty or value.
items.opportunity: Puka remains high-volume if active (post-Adams/Ferguson); JT handcuff/backup watch

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs post prior absence; unlikely to play without Friday practice.
items.implication: Likely OUT again; Worthy/others elevated in KC passing game.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for Xavier Worthy and TE/RBs

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (IR eligible) not expected ready soon—'will take some time.' Notable as biggest Adams beneficiary; Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams long absence funnels targets heavily to Nacua.
items.implication: Puka elite volume floor/ceiling when healthy; monitor calf.

items.text: T.J. Watt limited Thursday practice with calf; Coach Mike Tomlin/McCarthy doesn't believe it will impact inclusion Sunday.
items.implication: Steelers defense full strength expected; minimal fantasy skill impact.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers—quite bad (OL mess too). Long-term Jacobs outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive for return timeline; backups inefficient EPA signals Jacobs role secure when back.
items.implication: Jacobs stash/hold strong; fade pure backups until clearer.
items.opportunity: Jacobs workload resumption; limited backup upside
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs short-term workload question

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, Bears good for yardage, usage+matchup.
items.why: 33% target share, 97% routes recently despite drops; soft Bears secondary.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets vs vulnerable pass D

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (elite volume), Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions gift to pass catchers), Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR (big workloads, friendly matchups). Saquon in-line vs DAL.
items.why: Usage + soft matchups (Lions pass D, RB-friendly spots); Saquon efficient return.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN (target-share/low-scoring issues), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough pass D), Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload post-layoff), Cam Skattebo @ HOU (brutal spot).
items.conflict: Levitan more positive longer-term on Jacobs facility/EPA of backups

items.text: 10 Facts: Stroud QB upside (top yards/attempts); Nix tiny aDOT 5.4 (no WR viability); Jeanty inefficient/under 3 YPC often, Washington snap rise; Coker out-targeting/outscoring McMillan; AJ Brown buy (high share/routes despite drops); drop Brian Thomas (6% share); Mayer viable even w/ Bowers; Puka/TE share spike w/ Adams out.
items.why: Usage metrics, aDOT, snap/target shares, efficiency data.

items.text: JJ McCarthy YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but tough to ignore; Giants plan start McCarthy.
items.why: Poor historical YPT efficiency with McCarthy vs other QBs.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency concern if McCarthy starts long-term; volume still high but YPR/YPT risk.
items.opportunity: Still routes/targets but lower yards ceiling

items.text: Bears Week 10 bye then soft close: Saints (27th YPP allowed), Lions (24th), Jags (26th), Dolphins (21st), Bills (25th), Packers (3rd), Lions. Strong scoring early when healthy.
items.why: Favorable remaining defensive yards-per-play ranks post-bye.
items.implication: Bears skill players elevated ROS rankings/value.
